scientific_integrity: The prior smooth-boundary transition theorem and its log-cosh functional are expressly credited, and numerical calculations are described only as supplementary checks. No claim of independent external validation or historical priority certification is made.
scientific_limitations: Only the critical radial (-p)-mean covariogram regime is treated. Convergence has no rate for general nonsmooth bodies. The O(1/p) constants depend on the fixed polytope. Other alpha-regimes and fixed-p differentiability for polytopes are not asserted.
title: Critical smoothed-covariogram limits without boundary regularity
